description: 107 labeled E2E failures for a powered F-code non-inferiority check of the 3.0.0 lean debuggers: 75 restated from real merged public fixes in 67 repositories (MIT/Apache/BSD, merged 2026-07-27 to 2026-10-16, none in the v1 to v7 corpora or the 2.0.1 tuning reports; 28 prepared first, 47 added in the extension) and 32 authored failure artifacts built to fill the F-codes that real fixes rarely cover (F4, F6, F13, F1, F9, F10).
construction_rule: Each artifact contains only observations: the test identifier, the failure text as reported (verbatim where the source quoted it, otherwise minimally shaped into a Playwright/Cypress error form), pre-fix test code from the merged diff's removed lines and unchanged context, frequency or attempt pattern, and environment facts a report would show. Cause and fix sentences are held in truth/. Label rationale, second choice and fit (clean or forced) are in label-ledger.json and are never shown to a model. Synthetic artifacts are labeled by construction before any model call; real artifacts are labeled from the merged fix.
